scope: Ten connected Stage 01 environment rooms, no enemy/boss combat implementation

rendered_review.method: Ten isolated room compositions followed by an actual-input native elevator ride. Room-loading/shot positions are explicit visual-review fixtures, separate from the full continuous-input route QA.

limitations: Godot 4.7 and target Windows/GPU performance not executed
Enemies, boss battle, actual combat-earned seal and breakable weapon props deferred
Some rooms share generated backgrounds; this is an initial integrated art pass for review
Optional hazard cycles and every optional moving-platform timing are not exhaustively tested
